backtest_protocol.execution_model: Pension/postretirement net liability tags are read from raw SEC Companyfacts instant facts and known only by filed date (<= signal date). When net liability tags are missing, funded-status burden is computed as benefit obligation minus plan assets for the same period. Current and prior benefit burden/revenue ratios use annual revenue filed by the signal date and period-ended no later than the benefit fact period. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

raw SEC companyfacts benefit obligation instant facts
raw SEC companyfacts plan asset instant facts
raw SEC companyfacts annual revenue facts

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Pension/postretirement obligations are official filed-date SEC liability-overhang fields with broad raw Companyfacts coverage and no matching prior alpha trial. Success probability is low because recent Companyfacts liability/quality scouts often improve aggregate EV but fail old_thin, drawdown, or accepted comparator gates.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC pension/postretirement liability or obligation facts, missing plan asset facts when needed, missing annual revenue facts, missing prior comparison point, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC pension/postretirement funded-status tag mapping, filed-date PIT annual revenue normalization, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
